high_level_description: The image captures a dynamic scene of an Eurofighter jet taking off with its afterburners engaged. The aircraft is positioned centrally in the frame, angled slightly upwards as it ascends into the sky. The afterburners at the rear of the jet are visibly glowing orange-red, indicating that they are fully active, which is evident from the bright exhaust flames trailing behind the plane. The background features a rugged mountainous landscape, with rocky peaks and cliffs dominating the scene.
